name: Tessera
author: E. T. Carter
description: An irregular wall of dark glass tiles drawn by hairline grout seams, each pane faintly tinted from the palette. The tiling itself is alive: tiles shatter into smaller tesserae and clutches of chips fuse back into broad panes, newborn seams flashing softly as the wall forever re-tessellates itself.

params.label: Tile size
params.effect: Average diameter of a parent tile in CSS pixels; small values give dense mosaic chips, large values give broad panes.

params.label: Split rate
params.effect: How quickly an individual split or fuse plays out — from slow crystalline growth to a busy reshuffling of the wall.

params.label: Seam width
params.effect: Thickness of the bright grout lines between tiles; wider seams make the web dominate, hairline seams let the glass fills lead.

params.label: Churn
params.effect: Fraction of the wall in mid-transition at any moment; low values leave a calm wall with rare splits, high values keep the tessellation visibly boiling.
